#  44426 - Gas-Liquid-Solid Reactor Design Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **44426 - module is no longer offered from WS 2014/15**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Gas-Liquid-Solid Reactor Design**  |  
|  Auslegung von Gas-Liquid-Solid Reaktoren   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Schnitzlein, Klaus 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Solving multiphase reaction engineering problems by knowing the fundamentals and their applications.  |  
| Contents:  | 
  * Concepts and Definitions
  * Industrial Applications
  * Thermodynamics
  * Diffusion in Liquids
  * Mass Transfer
  * Kinetics
  * Experimental Methods for Evaluation of Parameters
  * Design and Operation of Multiphase Reactors 

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Heat and Mass Transfer, Thermodynamics, Chemical Reaction Engineering Fundamentals   |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Practical training / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Shah, Y. T., Gas-Liquid-Solid Reactor Design, McGraw Hill 1979
  * Gianetto, A. , Silveston, P. L., Multiphase Chemical Reactors, Springer 1986
  * Ramachandran, P. A., Chaudhari, R.V., Three-Phase Catalytic Reactors, Gordon and Breach 1983
  * Kastanek, F., Zahradnik, J., Kratochvil, J., Cermak, J., Chemical Reactors for Gas-Liquid Systems, Ellis Horwood 1993

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Exercises
  * Short tests
  * Lab reports
  * Written examination (120 min) 

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
